_comment: Template only. Copy to config/geofences.json (gitignored) to keep personal watch zones. Each fence is a closed lon/lat ring. layers currently supports sdpd-reports. The example watches Barrio Logan south of downtown along I-5, including the Home / Newton Ave blocks.

fences.name: Barrio Logan SW of I-5
fences.note: Barrio Logan south of Commercial Street and along I-5, from Harbor Drive east through the Home / Newton Ave blocks.
